SUCKS now after changes, I do NOT recommend this app. This used to be the best translation app for Mexican Spanish to English and vice versa. The best feature, that no other translation apps had, was the “alternative translations” option, where you could see other possible translations of what you put in. I used this frequently, because often the default English translation of the Spanish input did not make sense based on the context. However, one of the alternative translations pretty much always did, and I even confirmed with multiple Spanish speakers that the alternative translations were correct in most of those situations. Unfortunately, the dimwits running this app have removed the alternative translations option. And when I tried to explain why the alternative translations were so important, these morons told me to just input in Spanish what I want the “alternative translation” to be. Yes, you heard that right. They told me, a non-Spanish speaker, to input IN SPANISH what i “want” the alternative translation to be in English. If you are confused, it is because that makes no sense. If I knew what the correct translation would be, it would mean that I am a Spanish speaker and don’t need the app. The idiots at customer service seriously had no understanding of the fact that there can be more than one translation of a word/phrase/sentence, so I got nowhere with them in resolving the issue. And frankly, their stupidity resulted in straight up disrespectful behavior to me. So after years of paying for this app, I have discontinued my subscription. I truly hope this company goes out of business now. I’m assuming there must be new people running it or who own it, because like I said before, it used to be great. So that is the only reason I can think of that this app became trash and now defied logic. Oh, also, there is often to button available for me to click to even translate text anymore. So I will input the text to be translated, but there is no button to push to get it translated. Sometimes the button is there, sometimes it is not.

reviews.text: Very Helpful!. Excellent recurse, Helps a lot !!! In special when you have different Nationalities Friends! Love it!

Colloquialisms are marvelous things, but hard to pin down.. Without knowing the Colloquialisms - you do not know a language, nor the culture you are in.

Without knowing the language derogatory idioms specific to your perceived origins, and not knowing critical language swear words, a traveler’s life could be in danger, and they may never know it until it is too late.

These are two of my criteria used to evaluate a language translation program for excellence.

iTranslate Pro is one of the better translation applications available to the user in the Apple App Store. I would rate it Very Good for the common user for a relatively good translation. It does not include my two primary criteria.

However, it is not perfect. Using one of eleven languages in which I have conversed, Hausa, the second largest African language used primarily in West Africa as my example, iTranslate is using what I loosely term a transient “Metropolitan” Hausa as their base versus the pure Hausa from the heart of Hausaland centered in Sokoto.
